name: Temporal Color Histogram
description: Tracks color histogram changes over time
algorithm: Temporal Color Histogram — Statistical Pattern Analyzer
mechanism:
This method analyzes temporal color histogram evolution for deepfake detection:

1. **Regional色Histograms**: Per-frame color histograms are computed for multiple regions: face, skin, hair, background, and clothing. Histograms use perceptually uniform color bins (Lab color space) for meaningful color comparison.

2. **ヒストグラム時間的Smoothness**: The evolution of color histograms over time should be smooth. The method measures frame-to-frame histogram distance (EMD, chi-squared) and detects anomalous spikes. Deepfake generation may produce frame-to-frame color distribution jumps as the generator's color output varies.

3. **Inter-領域ヒストグラム相関**: Color changes in different regions should be correlated (same illumination affects all regions similarly). The method checks temporal correlation between regional histograms. Low face-background histogram correlation indicates the face color evolves independently from scene lighting — a deepfake signature.

4. **ヒストグラムShape分析**: The shape of color histograms encodes content characteristics. The method tracks histogram shape metrics (modes, spread, skewness) over time. Authentic video maintains consistent histogram shapes within the same scene. Deepfake generation may produce fluctuating histogram shapes.

5. **Long-Rangeヒストグラム一貫性**: The method compares histograms between frames separated by longer intervals. Scenes with stable lighting should show consistent histograms regardless of temporal distance. Systematic histogram drift without lighting change indicates gradual color shift from AI generation artifacts.
parameters:
分析タイプ: 統計
メディア: 動画
入力: Video frames extracted at key intervals
出力: 信頼度スコア (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: 中〜高 — 70-88% 単独精度. Most effective when combined with other 動画 forensic methods. Performance depends on 動画 quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detection of deepfake and AI-generated 動画 through temporal color histogram analysis. This method examines temporal and spatial features that are difficult for AI systems to perfectly replicate, providing evidence for 動画 authenticity assessment.
strengths:
• Captures temporal artifacts that single-frame analysis misses
• Works with standard 動画 formats
• Effective against common deepfake techniques
• Can be combined with other 動画 forensic methods
• Based on established computer vision research
limitations:
• Performance affected by 動画 compression and resolution
• Some methods require sufficient frame count for temporal analysis
• Effectiveness varies with deepfake generation technique
• Best used as part of a comprehensive multi-method pipeline
• May produce false positives on heavily edited authentic 動画
